applies_to.launch: agy --print <prompt> --output-format stream-json (headless print mode), raw standard output
applies_to.selection: route stdout; the stream reports no version: the capture discovers it once per run with agy --version (RULE-8) and declares the basis

interface_sources.documented: Antigravity CLI headless mode documentation (antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless, fetched 2026-10-23): one init event, step_update events, one result event per turn; the step_update, tool_info, subagent_info, init and result members; status values; usage, num_turns and duration_seconds of the result are cumulative over the session, response is the turn's own
interface_sources.changelog: google-antigravity/antigravity-cli CHANGELOG.md at tag 1.4.6 (fd851f1da40e4347f1d05d211dcb45f94aede4c4): stream-json introduced in 1.1.8 with tool_info (canonical tool name, parameters, output) and subagent_info; denied_actions reported since 1.1.27
interface_sources.unavailable: the emitter's source, a published typed schema or SDK, and vendor tests; the CHANGELOG (1.1.8) calls step_type a stable, closed vocabulary, but its members are not published: the documentation lists observed values, and 1.4.6 emitted two more (subagent, system_message)

executor: journal-ocsf-writer AntigravityStreamMapper (direct Java); one record at a time; no cross-record state

time_policy.reported: none: the stream carries no timestamps (duration_seconds is a duration, not a time)

identity: agy.stream.step_identity.v1: a step's identity is its step_index, documented as the zero-based index of the step in its conversation (step_update.conversation_id, which every record reports), written as decimal text in tool_call_uid or item_uid with identity_basis_id 99 Other and the caption sibling identity_basis "Conversation step index" (the OCSF convention for an Other value); it is neither a model-facing call identifier (the stream reports none) nor an identifier the output stream assigns to its own items; in one stdin session the numbering continues across turns (documented), whether a resumed conversation (--continue or --conversation, a new process) continues it is not established. Scope: a step index identifies a step only within its source artifact (journal.run_uid, journal.invocation_index, source_ref.artifact) and conversation (session_uid); an equal index in another artifact, run or conversation is another step, and no continuity across resumed processes is asserted

tool_kind_table.meaning: a tool step is classified by the exact tool name the step reports (step_update.tool_name, documented as the canonical tool name); names absent from the table are 99 other
tool_kind_table.note: Name table only. The kind describes the request; no operating-system effect is asserted, and a shell command's text is never read to choose a kind.

rules.settings: working_directory = init.cwd, permission_mode = init.permission_mode (request-review by default, always-proceed under --dangerously-skip-permissions), model = init.model and agent = init.agent only when reported, tool_names = init.tools exactly; session_uid = the record's conversation_id

rules.content: none: the stream reports that a user-input step happened, never its text; the prompt a capture passed is caller-supplied provenance in the run's launch settings, not vendor content

rules.owner: item_uid = step_index (agy.stream.step_identity.v1, identity_basis_id 99); no response_uid: the provider's response identifier is not reported, and whether one step is one model invocation is not established
rules.content: one block when text_delta is present: block_type text_delta, block_kind 1 Text, text = text_delta exactly, text_update_id 1 Increment (agy.stream.text_delta.v1: an increment of the step's response text; the step's text is the concatenation of its fragments in record order, as the documentation's jq -j example joins them)

rules.owner: item_uid = step_index (identity_basis_id 99); the response the step belongs to is not identified
rules.content: the step's last text_delta fragment as one text_delta block when present, text_update_id 1 Increment like every fragment (it ends, never restates, the step's text); a step without text_delta has no content block (the stream does not project the response's tool requests or other content)
rules.usage: step_update.usage -> scope 99 Other with scope "Conversation step" (the unit is the step this event identifies by item_uid), status 2 Final (reported once, on the step's DONE record), aggregation 1 Scope total of that step (agy.stream.step_usage.v2: documented as the step's own token usage; one step is not established as one model invocation, so the usage is never stated at scope 2 Model response); distinct steps' totals are disjoint, the result's session usage covers them and is never added to them; tranches by agy.usage.tranches.v1

rules.request: tool_name = step_update.tool_name, arguments = tool_info.parameters exactly (absent when not reported), reported_state = state; kind by agy.tool_name_to_kind.v1; a step that became active, not the model's own request: no response owner, model call id or permission decision follows from it (in request-review mode a command step becomes ACTIVE and is then soft-denied)

rules.result: tool_result.data = tool_info.output when reported, else tool_info.error when reported, else no result content; with tool_info.error (documented: present when the tool fails) error_reported true and status_id 2, basis 1 Reported; without it status_id 0, basis 3 Not derivable (agy.stream.tool_outcome.v1: DONE is a lifecycle state, and a missing error does not establish success: a soft-denied command reports DONE with neither output nor error); a command's exit status appears only inside the rendered output text and is not parsed; the record's own tool_name and tool_info.parameters stay in its retained data (the call's name, kind and arguments are on its start, joined by tool_call_uid)

rules.owner: tool_call_uid = step_index (identity_basis_id 99): the same step whose ACTIVE record, as a tool step named invoke_subagent, started the call
rules.result: tool_result.data = tool_info.output or tool_info.error when reported, else step_update.subagent_info exactly (each spawned subagent's type_name, role, initial_prompt, conversation_id, log_uri, workspace_uris as reported); status as for tool steps (agy.stream.tool_outcome.v1); no child run is linked: the child conversation's records are not in this stream, and its log file is never read

rules.status: result.status: SUCCESS 1 Success, ERROR 2 Failure, any other documented value (CANCELED, INTERRUPTED, INVALID, WAITING, RUNNING) 99 with the reported word as its label; basis 1 Reported
rules.content: result.response, documented as the turn's own response text, as one block (block_type response, block_kind 1 Text, no text_update: it is the turn's whole text, not an update of a step item, and is never concatenated with the steps' assembled text) when it is a string, including the empty string the CLI reports when no text was produced
rules.usage: result.usage -> scope 5 Session, status 2 Final for this run, aggregation 2 Cumulative snapshot (agy.stream.session_usage.v1: documented as cumulative over the session of one process; a conversation resumed by a new process is not covered by the documentation or the recordings). It covers the step totals of the conversation and is never added to them; it can exceed their sum (on an interrupted run it reported usage that no emitted step reports), and the steps' sum is never substituted for it; tranches by agy.usage.tranches.v1
rules.permission: each denied_actions[] entry -> one permission decision 2 Denied at scope 4 Run, reported_decision denied (the member name), attribution 3 Unattributed with no candidates, method 2 (agy.stream.denied_action_attribution.v1: an entry names a permission action category (for example command) and a display name, never a step index; it is not linked to a tool step by name, position or text); the entry is kept as the decision's data

rules.selector: checkpoint, system_message and unknown step types, step states with no rule, unknown events
rules.session: session_uid = the record's own conversation_id when it reports one

rules.selector: any line that is blank, not UTF-8, not one JSON object under strict duplicate-key parsing, or cut off by the end of the source
rules.residual: raw_data (text) or raw_bytes_b64 (bytes); parse_status_id 5 Incomplete at source end when the source ended mid-record

rules.selector: a parsed record whose mapper threw
rules.residual: whole record in data; basis names the exception. A defect of the writer is visible, never a lost record

usage_tranches.meaning: cache_read_tokens, output_tokens, thinking_tokens (as reasoning_tokens) and total_tokens (as reported_total_tokens) are copied as reported; input_tokens cannot include cache reads (cache_read_tokens exceeds it on 9 of the 18 usage objects of the 1.4.6 recordings and in the documentation's own example), but the stream reports no cache writes, so it is the uncached input only conditionally: the uncached component is unavailable with measurement status 3 Conditional and conditional_value = input_tokens (agy.usage.uncached_input.v1), never the canonical tranche; whether thinking_tokens is part of output_tokens is not stated, so no reasoning relation is written; no member's measurement status is stated otherwise

unavailable_at_source: the user prompt's text (a user_input step carries none)
model-facing tool call identifiers and provider response identifiers
the content of agent responses other than text_delta fragments (tool requests appear only as tool steps)
a structured exit status of run_command (rendered into tool_info.output text)
the written content of write_file (its parameters report the path only)
the step a denied_actions entry refers to
a spawned subagent's own activity and usage (only the spawn's subagent_info is reported)

step_update/checkpoint.meaning: a documented step type whose purpose the documentation does not describe; it can report usage, which the result's session usage includes
step_update/checkpoint.disposition: retained-only (meaning not established); its usage is not claimed as a model response's

step_update/system_message.meaning: an undocumented step type observed in 1.4.6 between agent-response steps of a run that spawned a subagent, DONE with a duration and no other content

candidate.status: Antigravity contract 0.2.0-prototype (2026-10-23 close-out), candidate for the managing reviewer: tested candidate behaviour, not approved support. Changed from 0.1.0-prototype: a step's own usage is stated at scope 99 Other "Conversation step" instead of 2 Model response, and every text_delta block states text_update_id 1 Increment (extension 0.10.0-prototype). Retained meanings: a conversation step index as identity (identity basis 99 Other with the caption "Conversation step index"; no dedicated enum value), scoped to its artifact and conversation

facts: a tool step can end in state ERROR with tool_info.error {type, message} (read_file on a directory), although the documentation lists only ACTIVE and DONE
result.response joined the text_delta fragments of every agent-response step of the turn (two steps in the subagent run)

on the four completed runs result.usage equalled the sum of the parent conversation's agent-response step usage (a spawned subagent's usage is not reported in this stream); on the interrupted run it exceeded the reported steps (input 9422 against 6925): usage that no emitted step reports, whose origin the stream does not report
on SIGTERM the CLI wrote a whole result record with status ERROR and error interrupted (not the documented INTERRUPTED) and exited 1

in request-review mode a command step became ACTIVE, then DONE with neither output nor error; the result reported SUCCESS, an empty response and denied_actions [{action: command, display_name: RunCommand}], and the run ended without the remaining requested steps
a tool step's tool_name (read_file, write_file) need not appear in init.tools (view_file, write_to_file)
cache_read_tokens exceeded input_tokens on 9 of 18 usage objects, so input_tokens excludes cache reads; total_tokens equalled input_tokens + output_tokens on every record
